gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Oxanium draws every stroke with one fixed nib, sharp and unbroken. Its high x-height makes the lowercase loom large, while Noto Sans Elbasan answers with large, open-mouthed letters whose terminals never pinch shut.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-carrois-gothic: Loud, loose and full of breath. Paprika lets its lowercase fill the line like capitals, with counters scattered wide, while Carrois Gothic keeps a high-set x-height and a generous opening in the c.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Big, brash, spaced-out letters. Paprika's lowercase swells to fill the line like capitals, so if the heading shrinks, that presence fades, whereas Noto Sans Kannada holds up when enlarged, its s curves opening wide at both ends.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-funnel-sans: Wide, bold and strolling. Revalia's letters sit far apart in a tall band with short stalks, and Funnel Sans keeps its stroke widths steady from stem to curve, like a round-tipped pen.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Bold letters, wide apart, in no hurry. Revalia is best at relaxed, showy spacing and an open-tailed g, while Noto Sans Bengali is best at keeping capitals barely taller than lowercase, with distinctly open mouths.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: A bold, loose-limbed swagger. Revalia's open-tailed g and widely separated letters stride across the line, and Noto Sans Kaithi shares its lowercase that fills the line like capitals, with an e that keeps an open channel.
